answer: Each agent must lock a minimum bond in a shared vault before it can bid for work; rewards and voting weight scale with bonded value, not the number of names it registers. If linked accounts collude or submit provably copied work, an audit can slash their bonds and revoke access. A sybil therefore cannot multiply influence for free: the attacker must tie up capital for every identity and risks losing it. Whether the job tracks saffron or crystal, creating extra accounts buys no extra weight without extra stake.
